name: Whirlpool WTW4100 Inlet Valve Coil Resistance (J8)
purpose: Hot, cold, and fabric softener solenoid coils on J8 — common J8-1 (GND) to valve pin.
failureModes: Open coil — no fill on that leg (F8E1)
Tens of ohms outside range — replace valve assembly
testingTips: W11800233 TEST #2 — Hot J8-1&5, Cold J8-1&3, Fabric Softener J8-1&6 (dispenser models)
Live valve test via Automatic Test Mode water valve sequence

name: Whirlpool WTW4100 PSC Motor Winding Resistance (J6)
purpose: PSC motor windings at J6 — CW J6-4↔6 and CCW J6-1↔6.
failureModes: Open winding — F7E6 motor circuit open
Good ohms but hum/no start — check run capacitor
testingTips: W11800233 TEST #3b — motor connector CW pins 2↔3, CCW pins 4↔2
Verify basket turns freely before condemning motor

name: Whirlpool WTW4100 Shifter Coil Resistance (J6)
purpose: Shifter motor coil at J6-2 and J6-6.
testingTips: Verify splutch cam moves freely before ohms
J2-1 shifter switch: SPIN +5 VDC / AGITATE 0 VDC vs J2-2 GND

name: Whirlpool WTW4100 Drain Pump Resistance (J6)
purpose: Drain pump winding at J6-3 and J6-6.
failureModes: In range but no run — check ACU drive or obstruction
testingTips: Drain pump pin 1→J6-3, pin 3→J6-6 harness continuity

name: Whirlpool WTW4100 Lid Lock Solenoid Resistance (J4)
purpose: Lid lock solenoid J4-2 to J4-1.
failureModes: Open solenoid — F5E3/F5E4 lid lock fault
Switch state wrong — replace lid lock mechanism
testingTips: Lock switch J4-3↔2: locked=0 Ω, unlocked=open
Lid switch J4-2↔1: lid open=open circuit

name: Whirlpool WTW4100 ACU HMI +12 VDC Supply (J5)
purpose: +12 VDC at J5-1 vs J5-4 (Circuit Gnd) when status LED indicates missing 5 VDC supply.
failureModes: Missing +12 VDC with LED off — ACU power supply fault
+12 V present but LED off — HMI load or harness short on J5
testingTips: W11800233 TEST #1 step 7 — disconnect J5 to isolate HMI load
Do not short pins inside J5 header during live checks
